input.overview: Royal Guard and add-a-ball Palace Guard reward early hits on the four moving center targets. Each color lights its matching upper target when the rail is left or its matching pop bumper when the rail is right. Light most of those features, then keep shooting up top and nudge toward the lit standups.
input.simpleOverview: In Royal Guard or Palace Guard, hit the colored targets on the moving center rail first. A hit lights the matching upper standup or pop bumper, depending on the rail position. After most features are lit, keep shooting up top and nudge toward lit standups and missing A-B-C-D-E lanes.
input.summary: This is a deferred upper-playfield game: improve the upper scoring with controlled rail hits, then stop challenging the rebound-heavy center. The five top letters light matching drain lanes; prioritize C so a center drain can at least score its higher value.

quickInfo.name: Moving colored targets
quickInfo.summary: Light same-color upper standups when the rail is left and same-color pop bumpers when it is right.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D-E lanes
quickInfo.summary: Each top lane lights the matching drain lane; C corresponds to the center drain.

quickInfo.name: Royal Guard
quickInfo.summary: Uses the lit features and drain lanes primarily for scoring.

quickInfo.name: Palace Guard
quickInfo.summary: Awards additional balls for all lit targets, all lit pop bumpers, and each completed A-B-C-D-E set.

steps.text: Plunge for C first when possible, then collect a different A-B-C-D-E top lane on later balls.
Shoot the moving center rail while its rebound is controllable, prioritizing colors whose upper standup is still dark.
After most upper targets and bumpers are lit, stop shooting the moving rail.
Send the ball up top and nudge bumper exits toward lit standups and missing top letters.
On Palace Guard, finish all target lights, all bumper lights, or A-B-C-D-E to add a ball when that feature is enabled.
Use the moving rail to light colored targets and bumpers.
Collect the improved features and complete missing top letters.

machineSetup: Identify Royal Guard versus add-a-ball Palace Guard and confirm whether the copy awards balls, replays, or points for completed color groups and A-B-C-D-E.
Test the moving rail across its full travel, all four colored snap targets and lamps, matching standups and pop bumpers, A-B-C-D-E rollovers, five drain-lane lamps and switches, and tilt behavior.
